cpu_attribution.timing_semantics: Diagnostic CPU attribution only, not unbiased latency or throughput; cumulative times overlap and must not be summed across nested calls. Speed quantiles come from the independent unprofiled benchmark.

status_cache.measurement: Controlled in-memory transport query count, not broker latency

interpretation.ingest_quantile_unit: one API call: batch up to 128 envelopes versus one envelope; do not divide these quantiles to claim whole-prefix speedup
interpretation.batching: existing durable atomic_batch path measured, not a newly invented storage mode
interpretation.new_optimization: bounded generation-aware status cache; open/close/management continue fresh reconciliation
interpretation.profiles: independent CPU-instrumented atomic-batch pass; confirmed equal functional/durable/query results against its own unprofiled identical context; not speed statistics

limitations: Synthetic fixture only; no broker, network, market, fill or profitability claim.
maxrss is reported as cumulative process high-water total and is not attributable to an individual operation; use a fresh subprocess for isolated baselines.
bytes_work_new measures positive SQLite-artifact footprint growth from the memory-pass baseline, not physical write amplification.
The unbatched route intentionally pays the existing one-envelope checkpoint cost; it is not a durability-disabled fast path.
A missing or vulnerable Protobuf runtime is reported explicitly and uses only a JSON fixture fallback.
Memory-pass elapsed time is intentionally excluded from speed statistics because tracemalloc is active.
